correction_note: Same-day revision per user review, 6 fixes: (1) financial_statements/monthly_revenue schema drift promoted to an independent Gate R3-S FAIL reason (SCHEMA_DRIFT_UNRESOLVED), not a disclosed-but-moot note; (2) institutional_gross/tdcc_weekly's self-contradictory unverified-optimistic+genuine_field/PASS classification corrected to a single unresolved/fixed_offset_proxy/FAIL classification on Gate R3-P, and added to failing_datasets; (3) reason_code fields changed from singular to reason_codes arrays to hold multiple independent grounds per gate; (4) new duplicate_key_audit block, status NOT_FULLY_EVALUATED; (5) new durable_identity block, DURABLE_IDENTITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED added to both R3-S and R3-P reason_codes; (6) R3-L summary/scope_note now explicitly limits the PASS to the approved committed baseline and marks the live working tree NOT_EVALUATED. Overall disposition (R3-L PASS scoped / R3-S FAIL / R3-P FAIL / R3-F,U,B,Q,I,N NOT_EVALUATED / NULL_BLOCKED_RESULT) is unchanged.

gate_results.scope_note: PASS is scoped strictly to the approved committed repository baseline (497a03ee...) and its docs-only descendant commits (current HEAD b97d3160...). The current LIVE WORKING TREE for core/data_provider.py and tej_importer.py carries substantial uncommitted changes (see phase_b_design_freeze.md §1.2.2) that are NOT part of this gate's evidence basis. gate_results.summary: All 6 target fields (decision-time universe, A-leg real_composite, value_ind, revenue_yoy, high52_prox, momentum) traced to a complete, unambiguous raw-dataset lineage, anchored to the committed baseline. D* frozen (first freeze).
not_evaluated_this_round: Live working-tree production lineage for core/data_provider.py / tej_importer.py (uncommitted TEJ_RUNTIME_OVERLAY_DIR merge layer, rewritten importer) — disclosed as a monitoring item, not scored.

gate_results.summary: 4 of 8 D* datasets FAIL, on two independent reason categories (coverage, schema drift); additionally, no D* dataset has an established durable corpus identity this round, and duplicate-key integrity was not fully evaluated (fail-fast/short-circuit, decisive FAIL already established on other grounds).

failing_datasets.schema_drift: 8/1952 per-stock files have release_date typed null (all-null column, i.e. 100% fallback-proxy for those 8 stocks) vs string in the remaining 1944 files.

failing_datasets.note: Contradicts tej_importer.py's own (currently uncommitted) docstring claim of 2004-01-02+ coverage; on-disk data matches that same docstring's description of the OLD pre-expansion seed window instead.

failing_datasets.coverage_note: Structurally near-full (2005-06-01 .. 2026-03-01); not a coverage failure. This dataset was INCORRECTLY recorded SUFFICIENT in an earlier draft — corrected this round: schema drift is an independent FAIL ground under AC-R3-2, not a disclosed-but-moot note.
failing_datasets.schema_drift: 187/2287 per-stock files have net_income/total_assets/total_liabilities/equity/operating_cash_flow/capex typed int64 instead of double.

duplicate_key_audit.what_was_done: Single-file sample (stock 1101) checked for duplicate (stock_id, date) rows in 4 of 8 D* datasets (price_valuation, revenue_growth, financial_statements, monthly_revenue); zero duplicates found in that one file per dataset.
duplicate_key_audit.what_was_not_done: No full-corpus sweep (covers <0.1% of files for the 4 sampled datasets, 0% for industry_map/institutional_flow/institutional_gross/tdcc_weekly). Cannot support a per-dataset SUFFICIENT/INSUFFICIENT verdict under AC-R3-3.
duplicate_key_audit.rationale: Fail-fast / short-circuit: Gate R3-S already has decisive, independently-established FAIL grounds (coverage + schema drift). A full-corpus duplicate-key sweep would not change this round's disposition and was not performed; not requested for this round either.
duplicate_key_audit.revision_policy_check: NOT_ATTEMPTED this round, out of scope given the fail-fast disposition.

durable_identity.detail: None of the 8 D* datasets received an independent byte copy or NFR-R3-3-compliant frozen corpus reference this round. tej_cache is not git-tracked; no byte copy was made (that action would itself have the shape of a partial Phase C snapshot, out of this round's authorized scope). All coverage/schema findings above are OBSERVED-CURRENT-CORPUS findings — valid to support this round's FAIL, not a claim of long-term reproducibility. See phase_b_design_freeze.md §2.7.

gate_results.summary: 5 of 8 D* datasets classified fixed_offset_proxy or unresolved/fixed_offset_proxy per AC-R3-7 (no genuine per-row evidence actually consumed by, or verified for, the producing chain); Gate R3-P FAILs unconditionally for each in the qualification track. Durable corpus identity not established for any D* dataset this round.
gate_results.correction_this_round: institutional_gross was previously (incorrectly) classified genuine_field/PASS in this same document while separately being described as 'potentially unverified-optimistic' — a self-contradictory pairing. institutional_gross and tdcc_weekly are now both classified unresolved/fixed_offset_proxy and moved into failing_datasets below (previously institutional_gross was absent from this list and tdcc_weekly sat in a softer 'flagged_not_yet_resolved' bucket).

failing_datasets.reason: No disclosure-date field exists at all (confirmed via tej_importer.py's own documentation).
Genuine release_date present 2019-01+ only; fixed +9d fallback elsewhere; partial coverage does not cure per AC-R3-7 item 1. Also fails Gate R3-S independently (coverage + schema drift).

Genuine release_date now exists in the raw dataset (2026-08-06 re-export) but is not read by core.tej_bundle._to_long(); a uniform 45-day fixed lag (PUBLISH_LAG_DAYS) is applied instead. Also fails Gate R3-S independently (schema drift).
Zero PIT lag applied by core.tej_bundle._tej_shareholding() with no confirmed genuine per-row availability evidence backing that treatment. Also fails Gate R3-S independently (coverage).

Zero PIT lag applied by A-leg's shareholding path; a separate consumer (alpha_gate_lab.py, non-target field) applies an explicit 4-day lag to the same dataset, evidence against treating zero-lag as safe. No confirmed genuine per-row availability evidence. Also fails Gate R3-S independently (coverage).

durable_identity.detail: Same basis as Gate R3-S's durable_identity block above — the dataset-level PIT classifications rest on the same non-durable, observed-current-corpus evidence. See phase_b_design_freeze.md §2.7.

disposition.statement: Gate R3-S and Gate R3-P both FAIL. Per §7.0, Phase C does not proceed. The study stops at Phase B. No snapshot, no qualification claim, no adapter, no tests, no further phase attempted this round.
